routingMechanism.decision: vercel.json `rewrites` (the platform's same-application routing layer) dispatch the experience paths to an ADDITIONAL Serverless Function at api/experience.ts (the `api` directory convention), with the ORIGINAL experience path carried in the `path` query parameter and reconstructed by deploy/experience.ts's experienceRequestPath before the dashboard dispatch.

documentedSources.page: Rewrites on Vercel (page front matter: last updated August 11, 2026; read 2026-09-22)
facts: a same-application rewrite to a Serverless Function CONVERTS the source path captures into QUERY parameters on the destination — the page's own example: {"source": "/resize/:width/:height", "destination": "/api/sharp"} 'converts a request like /resize/800/600 to /api/sharp?width=800&height=600'
wildcard forwarding: {"source": "/docs/:path*", "destination": "/help/:path*"} forwards multi-segment tails; destination query values mix literals and captures ("date=:year-:month")

framework considerations: 'Use vercel.json rewrites for same-application routing only when your framework doesn't provide native routing features' — the Fastify framework build has no native platform-level rewrite layer, so vercel.json rewrites is the sanctioned mechanism
functions are created from files under the api/ directory (the page's first-function example is api/hello.ts) — the universal convention alongside a framework build
the framework detection is orthogonal ('Framework-aware. Vercel detects and optimizes for your framework automatically')

documentedSources.page: the Fastify framework entrypoint detection (PPR-006's verified source, re-verified 2026-09-22)
facts: the root server.ts is the ONE root entry the framework detection captures — additional functions ride the api/ directory (PPR-006's live-run platform fact: `functions` patterns only match Serverless Functions inside the api directory; this routing uses NO functions key)

knownPlatformFactsApplied: one root entry per framework build — the root server.ts is untouched; the experience surface is an additional function

the live run's build ships deploy/manifests/*.json into the traced bundle by default — the experience function's file tracing ships the manifests the console reads the same way (to be confirmed in the Lead's build)
the same tsc transpilation emits ES-module syntax for every graph it builds — hence the two-function correction (below)
